dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, high-contrast light-grey 'O' and 'C' shaped loops with sharp outer edges transitioning to darker interior coat color, primarily located on the mid-lateral and posterior-dorsal regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid high-intensity clusters; light pixels are predominantly organized into thin linear filaments rather than concentrated blobs, with occasional high-intensity nodes at line intersections.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent circular markings in the mid-section form an elongated scalene triangle, with additional nodes on the posterior flank extending the geometry into an irregular pentagonal network.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Series of four distinct, parallel, vertically-oriented curvilinear scars or rake marks visible on the posterior-most section of the body.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive network of branching, filigreed light lines interconnecting the primary annuli, creating a complex, web-like topographical pattern across the upper flank.
